The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 [hereinafter referred to as 'MV Act'] by the Appellant, who is stated to be the 'hirer' of the vehicle which is subject matter of the accident in the present case.
2. Learned Counsel for the Appellant requests for an adjournment to make his submissions in the matter.

3. None appears for the Respondent Nos.2 and 3.
3.1 Respondent Nos.2 and 3 are accordingly proceeded with ex-parte.
4. Learned Counsel for the Respondent No.1 submits that the Respondent No.1 has not received any compensation.
5. An order dated 07.12.2023 passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court clearly sets out that a stay on the enforcement of the Impugned Award This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

1 6.

In view of the fact that there is a typographical error in the order dated 07.12.2023, it is directed that the stay on enforcement of the Impugned Award is only to the extent of the Appellant being jointly and severely liable with the Respondent Nos.2 and 3.
However, there is no stay of the Impugned Award as far as the Respondent No.1 is concerned.

6.1 Accordingly, the Respondent No.1 is at liberty to take appropriate steps for withdrawn of the compensation amount in terms of the scheme as is set out in the Impugned Award in accordance with law.
7. The order dated 07.12.2023 is modified to this extent as set out in paragraphs 6 and 6.1 above.

8. At request of learned Counsel for the Appellant, list on 04.12.2025.
9.

In the meantime, the parties shall file their respective written synopsis, not exceeding three pages each, at least three days before the next date of hearing, along with the compilation of judgments, if any, they wish to rely upon.
9.1 All judgments sought to be relied upon shall be filed with an index which also sets out the relevant paragraph numbers and the proposition of law that it sets forth.
10. The parties shall act based on the digitally signed copy of the order.
TARA VITASTA GANJU, J JULY 10, 2025/jn
